narration:1:1910621002:1.female: Magic light flares up, and the wounds on his body begin to slowly knit back together.

say:3:1910621003:1.male: I told you... not to intervene...
say:3:1910621003:1.female: I told you... not to intervene...

choice_prompt:6:1910621005.female: *Cough*... if only we had been here sooner...

say:7:1910621006:1.text: You can heal my wounds and quiet the sound in my mind. Perhaps you could've helped my family as well...
say:7:1910621006:1.source_cn: 你能治我的伤，使我脑海里的声音减弱，也许也能帮助他们…...
say:7:1910621006:1.male: You can heal my wounds and quiet the sound in my mind. Perhaps you could've helped my family as well...
say:7:1910621006:1.female: You can heal my wounds and quiet the sound in my mind. Perhaps you could've helped my family as well...

say:8:1910621007:1.text: You did for me. Your gift could've saved them...
say:8:1910621007:1.source_cn: 像对我一样，用你的天赋隔绝他们头脑中的鼓声……
say:8:1910621007:1.male: You did for me. Your gift could've saved them...
say:8:1910621007:1.female: You did for me. Your gift could've saved them...

say:9:1910621008:1.text: Maybe if I had met you earlier, things would've turned out different...
say:9:1910621008:1.source_cn: 如果早点认识你……会不会一切都不一样？
say:9:1910621008:1.male: Maybe if I had met you earlier, things would've turned out different...
say:9:1910621008:1.female: Maybe if I had met you earlier, things would've turned out different...

choice_prompt:10:1910621008.text: Maybe if I had met you earlier, things would've turned out different...
choice_prompt:10:1910621008.source_cn: 如果早点认识你……会不会一切都不一样？
choice_prompt:10:1910621008.male: Maybe if I had met you earlier, things would've turned out different...
choice_prompt:10:1910621008.female: Maybe if I had met you earlier, things would've turned out different...

say:11:1910621010:1.text: 五个月之前，深岩家族中还有一百一十三人……两周之前，十六人。
say:11:1910621010:1.source_cn: 五个月之前，深岩家族中还有一百一十三人……两周之前，十六人。

say:14:1910621012:1.text: That was when someone first heard the sound. It was a child even younger than Garnet.
say:14:1910621012:1.source_cn: 那时，第一次有人听到“声音”，是族裔中的一个幼童，年纪...

say:15:1910621013:1.text: 声音本不该存在，它们并非来自海底火山，或是深海巨兽，而是直接来自听者的脑海中。
say:15:1910621013:1.source_cn: 声音本不该存在，它们并非来自海底火山，或是深海巨兽，而...

say:16:1910621014:1.text: Then, the sound swelled until all else fell silent beside it. The drumming began to echo through the blood, hammer at the eardrums, and thrum at the heart. Beside a sound that vast, a person was scoured out into an empty husk.
say:16:1910621014:1.source_cn: 然后，那声音渐渐涨大，直至周遭一切与之相比噤若无声。鼓...

say:17:1910621015:1.text: Gluttony. Craving. Loneliness. Only the flesh of others could sate it! The urge to merge, to become one, was so desperate—after devouring your own brother, even your aged parents tasted so sweet!
say:17:1910621015:1.source_cn: 饕噬。渴求。孤寂。唯有他人的血肉才能餍足！想要合二为一...

say:18:1910621016:1.text: 最后，如你所见，深岩家族没人再是孤身一人，大家互相融合……混乱的意识，无数根腕足，永不停歇的鼓声，等待着下一个被吞噬的人……
say:18:1910621016:1.source_cn: 最后，如你所见，深岩家族没人再是孤身一人，大家互相融合...

say:19:1910621017:1.text: He's the reason why I kept my sanity. I don't care if I go mad, but I don't want him to go through this.
say:19:1910621017:1.source_cn: 他是我保持理智的原因，我沦为疯狂无所谓，但他不能经历这一切！
say:19:1910621017:1.male: He's the reason why I kept my sanity. I don't care if I go mad, but I don't want him to go through this.
say:19:1910621017:1.female: He's the reason why I kept my sanity. I don't care if I go mad, but I don't want him to go through this.

say:20:1910621018:1.text: I need to stop this before I go completely insane. I have to help him or... leave him. I refuse to devour my brother!
say:20:1910621018:1.source_cn: 我必须阻止！在彻底失去理智之前，帮助他，或者永远离开他...
say:20:1910621018:1.male: I need to stop this before I go completely insane. I have to help him or... leave him. I refuse to devour my brother!
say:20:1910621018:1.female: I need to stop this before I go completely insane. I have to help him or... leave him. I refuse to devour my brother!

say:21:1910621019:1.text: I had thought taking him away from Deepsea would help, but it didn't work.
say:21:1910621019:1.source_cn: 我以为带他离开深海，情况就会好转，但仍然不行。
say:21:1910621019:1.male: I had thought taking him away from Deepsea would help, but it didn't work.
say:21:1910621019:1.female: I had thought taking him away from Deepsea would help, but it didn't work.

choice:13:1:2.text: You still have your brother, Calix.
choice:13:1:2.male: You still have your brother, Calix.
choice:13:1:2.female: You still have your brother, Calix.

say:23:1910621021:1.text: Back in the old days, when night fell or what we call night here, our people would gather together, share the game people caught that day, and listen to the elders tell fantastical tales of our world.
say:23:1910621021:1.source_cn: 曾经在夜晚——如果那能叫夜晚的话——我们的族裔会聚在一...
say:23:1910621021:1.male: Back in the old days, when night fell or what we call night here, our people would gather together, share the game people caught that day, and listen to the elders tell fantastical tales of our world.
say:23:1910621021:1.female: Back in the old days, when night fell or what we call night here, our people would gather together, share the game people caught that day, and listen to the elders tell fantastical tales of our world.

say:24:1910621022:1.text: We would hone our hunting and combat skills together. We were young and looked forward to the day we would complete the trials ourselves. We dreamed of becoming great warriors and hunters and building our own clan...
say:24:1910621022:1.source_cn: 我们会一起磨炼狩猎与战斗的技巧……期待某天自己也能完成...
say:24:1910621022:1.male: We would hone our hunting and combat skills together. We were young and looked forward to the day we would complete the trials ourselves. We dreamed of becoming great warriors and hunters and building our own clan...
say:24:1910621022:1.female: We would hone our hunting and combat skills together. We were young and looked forward to the day we would complete the trials ourselves. We dreamed of becoming great warriors and hunters and building our own clan...

say:25:1910621023:1.text: We had peaceful times... just like the Shallowfolk.
say:25:1910621023:1.source_cn: 和浅海裔很像……的……宁静时光，我们也曾有过。
say:25:1910621023:1.male: We had peaceful times... just like the Shallowfolk.
say:25:1910621023:1.female: We had peaceful times... just like the Shallowfolk.

say:26:1910621024:1.text: Land-dweller, these incidents have occurred in other settlements of the Deepfolk.
say:26:1910621024:1.source_cn: 咳……陆地人，其他深海裔聚居之处，也出现了类似的事。
say:26:1910621024:1.male: Land-dweller, these incidents have occurred in other settlements of the Deepfolk.
say:26:1910621024:1.female: Land-dweller, these incidents have occurred in other settlements of the Deepfolk.

say:27:1910621025:1.text: 其他栖息地可能和深岩的领地一样，已是一片废墟。但如果你们想去看看，我会领路。
say:27:1910621025:1.source_cn: 其他栖息地可能和深岩的领地一样，已是一片废墟。但如果你...

choice_prompt:28:1910621025.text: 其他栖息地可能和深岩的领地一样，已是一片废墟。但如果你们想去看看，我会领路。

say:29:1910621026:1.text: 所有人。起初，我本以为只有深海裔才会受到影响，但如今塔拉萨中也出现了“听者”……只怕这片海域之中，无人能逃。
say:29:1910621026:1.source_cn: 所有人。起初，我本以为只有深海裔才会受到影响，但如今塔...

say:30:1910621027:1.text: Go find that Shallowfolk girl and that fuzzy head, and come find me later.
say:30:1910621027:1.source_cn: 去找那个毛头小子和浅海裔的女儿，但晚些回来。
say:30:1910621027:1.male: Go find that Shallowfolk girl and that fuzzy head, and come find me later.
say:30:1910621027:1.female: Go find that Shallowfolk girl and that fuzzy head, and come find me later.

say:31:1910621028:1.text: I need a moment to pay my respects...
say:31:1910621028:1.male: I need a moment to pay my respects...
say:31:1910621028:1.female: I need a moment to pay my respects...

say:32:1910621029:1.text: You do as he says and leave Calix half-kneeling where he is. He needs a moment to himself. He's mourning as he swears an oath. His voice, pained and intent, reaches your ears in broken fragments.
say:32:1910621029:1.source_cn: 你依言离开，留卡律一人半跪在原地，他需要一些个人空间。...
say:32:1910621029:1.male: You do as he says and leave Calix half-kneeling where he is. He needs a moment to himself. He's mourning as he swears an oath. His voice, pained and intent, reaches your ears in broken fragments.
say:32:1910621029:1.female: You do as he says and leave Calix half-kneeling where he is. He needs a moment to himself. He's mourning as he swears an oath. His voice, pained and intent, reaches your ears in broken fragments.

say:33:1910621030:1.text: 我会记住每一根腕足断裂的瞬间……记住你们变浑浊的眼睛，记住逼你们发疯的鼓声。
say:33:1910621030:1.source_cn: 我会记住每一根腕足断裂的瞬间……记住你们变浑浊的眼睛，...

say:34:1910621031:1.text: 我会找到它的源头，把它掐死。
say:34:1910621031:1.source_cn: 我会找到它的源头，把它掐死。

say:35:1910621032:1.text: 让它也听听，深岩家最后的子嗣……是怎么一边念着你们的名字，一边把它拖进同一座地狱。
say:35:1910621032:1.source_cn: 让它也听听，深岩家最后的子嗣……是怎么一边念着你们的名...

narration:38:1910621035:1.text: Not far away, you, Tolan, and Elphira turn to gaze at Calix, who is kneeling in mourning.
narration:38:1910621035:1.male: Not far away, you, Tolan, and Elphira turn to gaze at Calix, who is kneeling in mourning.
narration:38:1910621035:1.female: Not far away, you, Tolan, and Elphira turn to gaze at Calix, who is kneeling in mourning.

say:40:1910621036:1.text: Ugh, I put my foot in my mouth again. I called his family "ugly varmints"...
say:40:1910621036:1.source_cn: 咱又说错话了，咱刚才对那些东西喊“恶心的怪物”……
say:40:1910621036:1.male: Ugh, I put my foot in my mouth again. I called his family "ugly varmints"...
say:40:1910621036:1.female: Ugh, I put my foot in my mouth again. I called his family "ugly varmints"...

say:41:1910621037:1.text: I didn't know they were members of his clan.
say:41:1910621037:1.source_cn: 该死，咱不知道那是他的族裔啊！
say:41:1910621037:1.male: I didn't know they were members of his clan.
say:41:1910621037:1.female: I didn't know they were members of his clan.

say:42:1910621038:1.text: Mister Calix stayed behind not just to protect us... He's remembering them in his own way... Remembering that they were once people, not monsters.
say:42:1910621038:1.source_cn: 卡律先生留下来，不只是为了保护我们……他在用自己的方式...

say:43:1910621039:1.text: 他们也会唱童谣，会依赖父母，会互相帮忙……会为不得不伤害亲人而痛苦。
say:43:1910621039:1.source_cn: 他们也会唱童谣，会依赖父母，会互相帮忙……会为不得不伤...

say:44:1910621040:1.text: Tolan, I only wanted to protect my own family before. But now, I want to help Mister Calix too! He has endured more pain and grief than either of us.
say:44:1910621040:1.source_cn: 图澜，之前我只想着保护好自己的家人；但现在，我也想帮助...

say:45:1910621041:1.text: Although I don't know what we can do...
say:45:1910621041:1.source_cn: 虽然不知道我能做什么……

say:48:1910621044:1.text: How's the tentacle guy doing, boss?
say:48:1910621044:1.male: How's the tentacle guy doing, boss?
say:48:1910621044:1.female: How's the tentacle guy doing, boss lady?

choice_prompt:49:1910621044.text: How's the tentacle guy doing, boss?
choice_prompt:49:1910621044.male: How's the tentacle guy doing, boss?
choice_prompt:49:1910621044.female: How's the tentacle guy doing, boss lady?

say:50:1910621045:1.text: ... Yeah, let's wait a bit longer.
say:50:1910621045:1.male: ... Yeah, let's wait a bit longer.
say:50:1910621045:1.female: ... Yeah, let's wait a bit longer.

narration:51:1910621046:1.text: After a while, you all return to Calix's side.
narration:51:1910621046:1.male: After a while, you all return to Calix's side.
narration:51:1910621046:1.female: After a while, you all return to Calix's side.

narration:52:1910621047:1.text: He is still half-kneeling where he was, with his eyes looking out in the distance. However, his face is calmer than before.
narration:52:1910621047:1.male: He is still half-kneeling where he was, with his eyes looking out in the distance. However, his face is calmer than before.
narration:52:1910621047:1.female: He is still half-kneeling where he was, with his eyes looking out in the distance. However, his face is calmer than before.

say:55:1910621049:1.text: Yes, and none of us are hurt. Thank you.
say:55:1910621049:1.source_cn: 嗯，我们都没受伤，谢谢你。

say:57:1910621051:1.text: You lag a step behind and replay every scene you have witnessed in your mind. You try to piece together a clear train of thought from the fragmented accounts of different people.
say:57:1910621051:1.source_cn: 你落后一步，回想着自己所见的一幕幕，尝试从不同人支离破...
say:57:1910621051:1.male: You lag a step behind and replay every scene you have witnessed in your mind. You try to piece together a clear train of thought from the fragmented accounts of different people.
say:57:1910621051:1.female: You lag a step behind and replay every scene you have witnessed in your mind. You try to piece together a clear train of thought from the fragmented accounts of different people.

say:58:1910621052:1.text: Five months ago, the Deepfolk first began hearing the drumming sounds, and their condition kept worsening until Calix fled to the Middlesea with Garnet.
say:58:1910621052:1.source_cn: 五个月前，深海裔开始第一次听到“鼓声”，状况持续恶化，...
say:58:1910621052:1.male: Five months ago, the Deepfolk first began hearing the drumming sounds, and their condition kept worsening until Calix fled to the Middlesea with Garnet.
say:58:1910621052:1.female: Five months ago, the Deepfolk first began hearing the drumming sounds, and their condition kept worsening until Calix fled to the Middlesea with Garnet.

say:59:1910621053:1.source_cn: 一周前，本该在中海正常进行洄游季的浅海裔，却不受控制地...
say:59:1910621053:1.male: A week ago, the Shallowfolk, who should have been holding their renewal season in the Middlesea, fell into the depths as the Tidewarden dove. And then, people in Coralia began to hear the drumming.

say:60:1910621054:1.text: A few days ago, the glowing tide surged up from the Deepsea and surrounded Coralia. Before that, you had witnessed Deepfolk willingly walk into the glowing tide and dissolve into luminous foam.
say:60:1910621054:1.source_cn: 几天前，从深海涌来的潮光包围了塔拉萨，在那之前，你曾见...
say:60:1910621054:1.male: A few days ago, the glowing tide surged up from the Deepsea and surrounded Coralia. Before that, you had witnessed Deepfolk willingly walk into the glowing tide and dissolve into luminous foam.
say:60:1910621054:1.female: A few days ago, the glowing tide surged up from the Deepsea and surrounded Coralia. Before that, you had witnessed Deepfolk willingly walk into the glowing tide and dissolve into luminous foam.

say:61:1910621055:1.text: Just now, Calix's clansmen were dispatched, and their corpses turned into specks of light and flew off in a certain direction...
say:61:1910621055:1.source_cn: 刚才卡律亲手送别的同族，他们的尸体变为光点，飞向了某一...
say:61:1910621055:1.male: Just now, Calix's clansmen were dispatched, and their corpses turned into specks of light and flew off in a certain direction...
say:61:1910621055:1.female: Just now, Calix's clansmen were dispatched, and their corpses turned into specks of light and flew off in a certain direction...

say:62:1910621056:1.text: 你抬头望去，眼前正是缓缓步入深海的下行海床。前面三人正停下等你，艾菲拉还担忧地向你挥了挥手。
say:62:1910621056:1.source_cn: 你抬头望去，眼前正是缓缓步入深海的下行海床。前面三人正...

say:63:1910621057:1.text: You nod and quicken your pace to catch up with them. You expend a bit more of your magic to tend to Calix's wounds, but for now, at least, you can still hold on.
say:63:1910621057:1.source_cn: 你点点头，快步追上他们。为了给卡律疗伤，你又消耗了些许...
say:63:1910621057:1.male: You nod and quicken your pace to catch up with them. You expend a bit more of your magic to tend to Calix's wounds, but for now, at least, you can still hold on.
say:63:1910621057:1.female: You nod and quicken your pace to catch up with them. You expend a bit more of your magic to tend to Calix's wounds, but for now, at least, you can still hold on.

choice:49:1:2.text: He just needs some personal space.
choice:49:1:2.source_cn: 他只是需要一些个人空间
choice:49:1:2.male: He just needs some personal space.
choice:49:1:2.female: He just needs some personal space.

choice:49:2:3.text: Let's give him a moment, and then we can meet up.
choice:49:2:3.source_cn: 稍待一会儿，一起回去吧
choice:49:2:3.male: Let's give him a moment, and then we can meet up.
choice:49:2:3.female: Let's give him a moment, and then we can meet up.

choice:47:0:1.text: We can accompany him as he seeks the truth.
choice:47:0:1.source_cn: 陪他一起走完探寻真相的路
choice:47:0:1.male: We can accompany him as he seeks the truth.
choice:47:0:1.female: We can accompany him as he seeks the truth.

choice:47:1:2.text: Just let him know that we'll be there for him.
choice:47:1:2.source_cn: 只要让他知道，我们会陪着他
choice:47:1:2.male: Just let him know that we'll be there for him.
choice:47:1:2.female: Just let him know that we'll be there for him.

choice:47:2:3.text: One sign of growing up is learning when to be silent.
choice:47:2:3.source_cn: 成长的标志之一是学会沉默
choice:47:2:3.male: One sign of growing up is learning when to be silent.
choice:47:2:3.female: One sign of growing up is learning when to be silent.

choice:28:0:1.text: So it isn't just your clan...
choice:28:0:1.male: So it isn't just your clan...
choice:28:0:1.female: So it isn't just your clan...

choice:13:2:3.text: You did the best you could.

choice:13:2:3.male: You did the best you could.
choice:13:2:3.female: You did the best you could.

choice:10:0:1.text: You don't know that. The cause is still unknown.
choice:10:0:1.male: You don't know that. The cause is still unknown.
choice:10:0:1.female: You don't know that. The cause is still unknown.

say:67:1910621009:1.text: You think really highly of yourself, don't you?
say:67:1910621009:1.male: You think really highly of yourself, don't you?
say:67:1910621009:1.female: You think really highly of yourself, don't you?

choice:10:1:2.text: Maybe it's because I came that these misfortunes happened...
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 也许因为我来了，才有倒霉事发生
choice:10:1:2.male: Maybe it's because I came that these misfortunes happened...
choice:10:1:2.female: Maybe it's because I came that these misfortunes happened...

choice:4:0:1.text: You tended to your clan. I healed my companion.
choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 你帮助你的族人，我治疗我的同伴
choice:4:0:1.male: You tended to your clan. I healed my companion.
choice:4:0:1.female: You tended to your clan. I healed my companion.
